tools.skillOrder.intro:
Comprehensively find the optimal order to place your team's cards, to optimize score.

Properly calculates skill restrictions (probabilities, bloom, levels, blue skill board, and activation restrictions such as needing specific combo or team cards). If inaccuracies occur, please report in the Discord! (source edited)

tools.skillOrder.bestNote: Assumes every active skill always activates, theoretical highest possible score.
tools.skillOrder.consistencyNote: Weighted by each active skill's activation chance to get the optimal order for consistently higher score, but may not be the highest possible.
tools.skillOrder.exactNote: The orders are picked by the same exact evaluator the Team Optimizer and Team Compare use, so all three tools agree on the best order. The gains and timelines below explain each pick.
